recipes.title: Lemon Chickpea Salad
recipes.description: A bright pantry salad with cucumber, parsley and a lemon dressing.

steps.text: Dice the cucumber, halve the tomatoes and chop the parsley.
Whisk the olive oil and lemon juice with salt and pepper. Toss with the chickpeas and vegetables.

recipes.notes: Add crumbled feta just before serving if you like.
